spanish: Y todo el tocante en todo utensilio que se siente sobre él lavará sus vestidos, y se lavará en las aguas, y se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: “que se siente sobre él” takes the utensil (nearest antecedent) as what feels/sits on a masculine él. תֵּשֵׁב is qal imperfect 3fs (she sits); עָלָיו resumes the masculine vessel as the place sat on. The feminine sitter is omitted and sitter and seat are reversed. Indicative “se siente” is sentir (feel), not sit.
“hasta la tarde” may be heard as until afternoon; עַד הָעָרֶב is until the evening. Uncertain whether the evening limit is kept.

notes: Wash-clothes, bathe in the waters, and be unclean until the stated limit stay 3ms with the toucher.
